name: Files
author: Carmine Paolino
description: Find files and folders as you type, browse folders, preview text and images, and act on results. Open with Ctrl+Alt+Super+Space after configuring it in Files settings, or run omarchy-shell shell toggle crmne.files. The settings button inside the overlay configures search folders, exclusions, previews, and the shortcut. Applying a shortcut explicitly writes a dedicated Hyprland file and loads it from bindings.lua; installation does not change your bindings.
